title: Chinese-Style Bresaola Wrap
description: A fusion of Chinese flavors and Italian-inspired bresaola in a crispy wrap. This dish is perfect for a quick and easy lunch or snack.
instructions: Preheat a pan over medium heat.
Slice the bresaola into thin strips.
Add the xtra to the pan and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add the crunchy to the pan and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Add the sliced bresaola and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add the spanish to the pan and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Warm the wrap in the microwave for 10 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by placing the bresaola mixture onto the wrap.
